address_reconfiguration.interpretation: Per-digit Zeeman cost is vastly below thermal; address-reconfiguration alone is NOT the dominant barrier.

topological_charge_barrier.interpretation: Total un-knotting cost across N_Trp anchor sites; dominant barrier.

phason_mass_reference.interpretation: Tier-3 Weinberg-candidate scalar M_P phi^(-147) ~ 2.2 meV. This is an O.37 alternative scale candidate, not the operative biogenic-DE quartic mass and not a branch-switching barrier input.

wkb_tunneling.interpretation: At every biologically accessible energy channel, branch-switching tunneling probability is operationally zero.

closure_status.tier: Tier 2 structural (homotopy continuity); Tier 3 conditional barrier magnitude (O.21 branch; no Level-II verdict)
closure_status.claim: Identity path is strictly continuous within homotopy class. Distal-branch jumps require E ~ 1.62e+09 eV per polaron un-knotting event, exceeding all biological energy channels by more than 9 orders of magnitude. Tunneling probability at thermal < 10^(-N) with N exceeding 10^10.
closure_status.remaining_open_research_level: Exact functional form of the un-knotting saddle-point trajectory in phason field space; the binding-energy estimate per Trp uses a hydrophobic-pocket scaling argument rather than first-principles DFT.
